local.rationale: kraal runs local agent CLI processes in its terminal panes. The documentation supports kraal sessions and coding agents on user-owned SSH servers, whose agents can be listed and reached from the client. The terminal can detach or close while the kraal session continues on its execution host. A local host sleeping is a different event and is not covered.
